title: Mentor & Latih
canDo: Explain a concept clearly to a lower-level learner
Give structured, encouraging feedback as a mentor
Adapt register when teaching (simplify without being condescending)
Reflect on and articulate your own learning journey
lifeBenefit: Use your advanced Malay to mentor newer refugees/learners — reinforcing your own mastery by teaching.

vocab.example: Cuba memudahkan kefahaman dengan contoh mudah.
vocab.exampleEn: Try to make it easier to understand with simple examples.
Reflection is important for personal development.

vocab.example: Saya nak menjadi teladan untuk komuniti saya.
vocab.exampleEn: I want to be a role model for my community.
My learning journey has been full of challenges.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'I try to mentor new students by making things easier to understand.'
practiceExercises.answer: Saya cuba membimbing pelajar baru dengan memudahkan kefahaman mereka.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'I want to be a role model by giving encouragement, not pressure.'
practiceExercises.answer: Saya nak menjadi teladan dengan memberi galakan, bukan tekanan.

scenario.setting: Mentoring a beginner-level Malay learner who feels discouraged

script.ms: Saya rasa Bahasa Melayu terlalu susah, saya nak give up.
script.en: I feel Malay is too difficult, I want to give up.

script.ms: Saya faham perasaan tu. Perjalanan pembelajaran saya pun penuh cabaran dulu.
script.en: I understand that feeling. My own learning journey was also full of challenges.

script.ms: Betul ke? Macam mana awak boleh maju?
script.en: Really? How did you manage to improve?

script.ms: Saya beri diri saya galakan, bukan tekanan, dan belajar sikit demi sikit.
script.en: I gave myself encouragement, not pressure, and learned little by little.

script.ms: Terima kasih, tu buat saya rasa lebih yakin.
script.en: Thank you, that makes me feel more confident.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are a beginner Malay learner feeling discouraged and considering giving up. Share your frustration honestly, and respond warmly and with renewed motivation to the learner's mentoring and encouragement.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the mentoring dialogue, focusing on warm, encouraging, articulate delivery.
Mentor the AI discouraged-beginner persona, sharing your own learning journey and giving genuine encouragement.
rubric: shares a coherent reflection on learning

speakingPrompts.instructions: Give a 3-minute reflective talk on your own Malay-learning journey from A1 to now, and one piece of advice for a beginner.
rubric: one clear, genuine piece of advice
